name: Philyth
source:
Philyth is an angel and part of the imperial guards of Flaithis. Philyth is very quiet and noble-minded, an angel of feminine beauty. Although he appears very graceful, soft, and delicate, he also hides a playful side and will sometimes crack a smile or laugh when least expected. He is the type that offers a gentle and affectionate romance.
